description: Schema for not-interesting interest applications. Marks a target entity as not interesting so it is filtered out of query results and views (unless 'show hidden items' is selected). Optionally scoped to a user and/or a view; when neither is present, it applies globally.

target.description: The entity marked not interesting (any entity type).

user.description: Optional user for whom the target is not interesting (user scope).

view.description: Optional view in which the target is not interesting (view scope).
